description: `jev-latest` is the alias TypeSafe's own client SDKs send when a caller names no model. It resolves upstream to the newest official Jev release, which is currently `jev-1.13.0`. The catalog publishes it as its own entry so an SDK-default request resolves to a price instead of answering 502 for a name the catalog does not carry. The alias moves when TypeSafe ships a release, so its answers can change without a change on this side; a workload that has tuned confidence thresholds should pin `jev-1.13.0` instead. TypeSafe also documents a `jev-preview` alias (currently resolving to the same version); it is left unpublished so traffic stays on a stable release.
